title: Warm German Pilaf with Almonds
description: A hearty and comforting German-inspired pilaf dish loaded with toasted almonds and warm spices.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add pilaf mix, caraway seed, and salt. Stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in toasted almonds.
Serve warm, garnished with additional almonds if desired.
